# NowFocus

> NowFocus is a privacy-first focus app for Android, macOS and Windows. It blocks distracting apps and sites during a focus session and makes quitting early a decision, not a reflex. Everything runs on the device; there is no account.

Status (2026-10-01): free, but not published to any store and no download links yet. Android has an early-access build (v0.3) and is furthest along; macOS is an early unreleased build; Windows is in development; iOS is planned. No cross-device sync yet. It is a self-control tool, not a lock: someone determined to uninstall it still can. There is a waitlist (email, platforms, optional feature request) on every page of the site; feature requests are posted publicly as GitHub issues, emails are not.

## Pages

- [Home](https://nowfocus.online/): what NowFocus is, how a session works, and why it differs from typical blockers
- [Download](https://nowfocus.online/download/): platform status, requirements, feature comparison and FAQ
- [Android guide](https://nowfocus.online/download/android/): requirements, setup, every screen, limits and uninstall
- [macOS guide](https://nowfocus.online/download/macos/): requirements, setup, limits and uninstall
- [Windows guide](https://nowfocus.online/download/windows/): requirements, status, limits and uninstall

## Articles

- [Blog](https://nowfocus.online/blog/): essays, updates, and engineering notes
- [Why NowFocus?](https://nowfocus.online/blog/why-nowfocus/): the problem with willpower, bypassable timers, and structural friction
- [Freedom Alternative](https://nowfocus.online/blog/freedom-alternative/): why local-first focus beats VPN profiles, cloud surveillance, and subscriptions
- [Cold Turkey for Mac and Mobile](https://nowfocus.online/blog/cold-turkey-mac-and-mobile/): closing the cross-device loophole left by desktop-only blockers
- [Opal Alternative for Android](https://nowfocus.online/blog/opal-alternative-android/): native Android accessibility, feed blocking, and strict focus without the $99/year fee
- [Forest Alternative](https://nowfocus.online/blog/forest-alternative/): why structural friction beats cartoon trees for serious deep work
